subject: Vendr portal: clarification on evidence owners and S3 proofs
messages:
From: Anika Shah <anika.shah@acmecorp.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>
Cc: security-onboarding@acmecorp.com
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 13:12:00 -0400
Subject: Vendr portal onboarding — owner mapping for evidence

Hi Camila,

Thanks for getting Vendr set up for Acme. Our compliance team ran a quick scan of the profile and flagged three items we need clarified before we finish the portal handoff: 

1) For all S3-hosted evidence links you referenced in the CAIQ, can you confirm the canonical owner for each bucket (Redwood team vs. customer service account)? We need a named steward to put in our inventory.
2) We saw a KMS rotation note but no rotation logs attached. Can you provide a recent rotation audit (last 90 days) or point us to where it will live?
3) For the SIG mappings, who on your side will be the point for ongoing updates — i.e., who has permission to edit the Vendr profile?

If easier, we can hop on a short call to run through the assets. Goal is simply to mark the profile as "evidence verified" in our system by EOW.

Thanks,
Anika
Anika Shah
Senior Security PM — Acme Corporation
security-onboarding@acmecorp.com

--

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwood.com>

Cc: Rafael Mendes <rafael@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Apr 2028 15:04:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Vendr portal onboarding — owner mapping for evidence

Hi Anika — thanks for the clear list. Short answers inline, and I looped in Rafael and Ben for the artifacts: 

1) S3 buckets: the majority are owned by our infra team under the account redwood-evidence-prod (steward: Rafael Mendes). There are two exception buckets (ingest-temp and qna-deltas) that are owned by the integration service account (team: Platform Integrations, steward: Ben Carter). I'll map these explicitly below.

2) KMS rotation logs: we have a rotation ledger exported to CSV for the last 90 days. Rafael — can you attach the rotation log and confirm the KMS alias we should cite?

3) SIG/CAIQ edit permissions: Marissa is the profile steward with edit rights in Vendr. Marissa, please confirm you can receive update requests and whether you'd prefer them via this thread or the internal ticketing flow.

If it helps, I'm happy to do a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk the proof links. Proposed times: Tue 9–11am PT or Wed 1–3pm PT.

Camila Reyes
Security Partnerships — Redwood Inference
camila@redwood.com

- redwood-s3-prooflist-2028-04.pdf: list of evidence objects, bucket name, object path, and owner tag (redwood-infra or platform-integrations).
- kms-rotation-log-sample.csv: sample rotation entries for alias "alias/redwood-evidence-kms" covering the past 90 days (rotation_id, timestamp, rotated_by, notes).

Bucket owner summary (short):
- s3://redwood-evidence-prod/evidence/ — steward: Rafael Mendes (redwood-infra)

- s3://redwood-qna-deltas/ — steward: Ben Carter (platform-integrations)

Marissa — Rafael recommends you be listed as the profile editor in Vendr and to enable the Acme security contact (anika.shah@acmecorp.com) as a read-only reviewer. If you can confirm, we'll reply and ask Acme to mark the profile verified.
